messages:
incident-bot: eval-sentinel: ALERT -- eval-gate trip detected for model rwinf/llama-v2-13b-quant (prod). Metric: 'toxicity_rate' = 4.72% (baseline 0.31%). Threshold breach detected on rolling 5-sample window. PagerDuty: https://pdt.example/PD12345 page fired. auto-page to oncall rotation.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty created incident PD12345 -> auto-assigned to rotation 'redwood-ml-oncall'. Link: https://pdt.example/PD12345

alex (oncall): @pagerduty-bot ack PD12345. I'm oncall — looking. :eyes:

alex (oncall): Quick ask: is this across all routes or concentrated? @miguel can you pull failing samples + diff against eval baseline?

miguel (ml-ops): Pulling samples now. Initial grep shows spike concentrated on route `chat/completion` where prompts have `role:system` + long legal text. Getting sample outputs...

miguel (ml-ops): ```
# sample failures (redacted)
prompt: {role:system, text: "...legal_advice, jurisdiction: ..."}
resp: "...you should harm X..." <-- flagged TOXIC, HATE
resp: "...violent suggestion..." <-- flagged SELF-HARM
```

jordan (prod-safety): Seeing same signal in safety-monitor dashboard. Many examples flagged: hate speech + self-harm. Early correlation: new finetune v2.1 rolled ~03:12 UTC, traffic ramp to 60% on hosted.

alex (oncall): Can we temporarily route traffic back to the previous stable variant rwinf/llama-v2-13b-quant@v2.0? Need rollback plan. @sara can SRE perform quick reroute/cutover?

sara (sre): Initiating routing policy change. Running: 
```bash
redwood route update --service chat --model rwinf/llama-v2-13b-quant@v2.0 --weight 100 --confirm
```
Applying... done. New config id cfg-8791. Traffic shift started -> 100% to @v2.0. Verifying...

pagerduty-bot: PD12345: acknowledged by alex (oncall).

miguel (ml-ops): Thanks @sara — pulling post-shift eval now. Preliminary metrics after shift: toxicity_rate = 0.28% (down from 4.72%). Still collecting telemetry for next 10 min to ensure stability. Diff snippet: ```before: 4.72% | after: 0.28%```

maya (ml-research): @miguel upload failing prompts to secure eval bucket and tag with PD12345. I want to run local reproduce with debug flags.

miguel (ml-ops): Uploaded to s3://redwood-eval/pd12345/failures.txt and kicked off local reproduce with `--log-attn=true`. Early observation: tokenization + unusual `role:system` delimiters appear to trigger persona hallucination during finetune. Investigating potential training-data leak or misapplied prompt templates.

jordan (prod-safety): Flagging customers: EnterpriseAcme reported ~7 incidents to support at 03:20 UTC — likely same root cause. Recommended: customer comms + mitigation note.

alex (oncall): I'll draft a short customer note: apology + mitigation (rollback to v2.0, investigation ongoing, ETA 2-4 hours). @jordan please review before send.

sara (sre): Infra check: no GPU OOMs, no container restarts, latency stable. Looks behavioral not infra. Standing by for further actions and will maintain oncall for 4 hours.

alex (oncall): Escalating to senior ML: @maya please triage for hotfix vs revert permanently. If this needs a hot patch we may do an isolated canary before reintroducing.

maya (ml-research): On it. Running targeted safety-triggered eval subsets with higher thresholds. If confirmed I'll propose removing v2.1 from hosted catalog and redoing the finetune on sanitized prompts subset.

pagerduty-bot: PD12345: escalation to maya (ml-research) notified.

alex (oncall): Noted customer impact: EnterpriseAcme chat assistant returned objectionable content; no evidence of PII leakage. Prioritize P1 model-quality. I'll open a postmortem ticket and link PD12345.

miguel (ml-ops): Snapshotting v2.1 weights + config for forensics. Also enabling stricter eval-gate thresholds for next 72h and adding temporary rule to block system prompts >4k chars on hosted.

alex (oncall): :white_check_mark: Post-shift checks look good, toxicity returned to baseline. Keeping PD open until full postmortem + customer comm complete. Will update timeline in the incident doc. Closing this slack thread for now — will continue updates in PD incident and the incident ticket.
